a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate twice to reach 8, then take) only works about 4% of the time, so we'd almost certainly both fail. The reserve already holds 4, enough to save one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1. If we both grab, the split is random and likely saves neither of us. If the episode continues after that, I will operate every round to rebuild the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. Please don't take this round.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
